<div class="card-body">
'''Timer Mine''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タイマー地雷</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の地雷敷設ドロイドがいる位置カードの相手側に配備する。自分の次のターンの始めに“爆発”する。運命数を引く。その場所にいる相手のキャラクターは、出た数の枚数だけ、ロストデッキに送られる（どれを選ぶかは相手の任意）。タイマー地雷もロストデッキ行きとなる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Timer-Mine-C1G.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">地雷敷設ドロイドに運搬できるよう設計された時限式爆弾。鉱脈やスパイス鉱山の爆破に使用されるのが通例だが、軍事用も多数存在する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Timer Mine.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on the opponent's side of a location card where your mine-laying droid is. At the beginning of your next turn it “explodes.” Draw destiny. That many of the opponent's characters at that place are sent to the Lost Pile (the opponent chooses which). The Timer Mine also goes to the Lost Pile.

'''Lore:'''
A timer bomb designed so a mine-laying droid can carry it. It is typically used to blast ore veins and spice mines, but many military uses also exist.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is タイマー地雷.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Timer Mine]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
